newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 16,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 16,000 tonnes of lentils for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 16,000 tonnes of lentils for export, an official spokesman said on Wednesday.
He told Reuters that an international call for prices setting March 18 as the final date to receive bids had been issued. Confirmation would be made on March 19.
The spokesman said the lentils would be ready for shipment between April 15 and May 15.
Partial offers would be acceptable up to 1,000 tonnes and the establishment has the right to partial confirmation, he said.
